newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' nine-month car sales up 26 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' nine-month car sales up 26 pct.

text.p: Total car sales in the Philippines in the first nine months of 1996 rose 26 percent to 65,421 units from 51,788 units in the same 1995 period, Honda Cars Philippines Inc said on Wednesday.
The Honda Motor Co unit was citing preliminary data from the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines.
The sales figures for the latest nine-month period covered 13 car assemblers. Figures were not yet available for sales of Daewoo and Mercedes Benz cars.
Japanese car assemblers continued to dominate the market, led by Honda with 15,008 units or a market share of 22.9 percent for January to September.

This was followed by Toyota Motor Philippines Corp with sales of 14,105 units or a share of 21.6 percent; Mitsubishi Motors, 11,244 units or 17.2 percent; and Nissan Motor Philippines Inc, 9,283 units or 14.2 percent.
